hooks.command: R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; [ -f "$R/.loki/loki.py" ] || git -C "$R" cat-file -e HEAD:.loki/loki.py 2>/dev/null || [ -z "$(git -C "$R" rev-list -1 --all -- .loki/loki.py 2>/dev/null)" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: .loki/loki.py is not on this branch; Loki did not check this' >&2; exit 0; }; python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.loki/loki.py" protect --harness codex || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: hook command failed' >&2; exit 2; }

R="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; [ -f "$R/.loki/loki.py" ] || git -C "$R" cat-file -e HEAD:.loki/loki.py 2>/dev/null || [ -z "$(git -C "$R" rev-list -1 --all -- .loki/loki.py 2>/dev/null)" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: .loki/loki.py is not on this branch; Loki did not check this' >&2; exit 0; }; python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.loki/loki.py" context --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" --event SessionStart || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: context unavailable' >&2; exit 2; }
